intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Scottsdale for 2026, and here is what he found: 29 family events, 24 of them free. The magic runs from November 6 (Photos with Santa at Scottsdale Fashion Square) through January 2, with Christmas at the Princess (from November 20), Holiday Lights at McCormick-Stillman Railroad Park (from November 27), the Tree Lighting Spectacular at Scottsdale Waterfront (November 28), Winter at the Waterfront (December 5) and the North Scottsdale Christmas Festival (December 6) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Scottsdale

  • 29 Christmas events for kids in Scottsdale
  • 24 free events, including the Tree Lighting Spectacular, Winter at the Waterfront and Starlight Movie Night: Elf
  • Meet Santa: Photos with Santa at Scottsdale Fashion Square and Kierland Commons, Sensory Santa on December 6, Omni Lights Up the Holidays (December 4) and Breakfast with Santa at Omni Scottsdale Resort and Spa at Montelucia (December 12)
  • Tree lightings and lights: Tree Lighting Spectacular (November 28), Annual Tree Lighting at Scottsdale Quarter (November 28) and Holiday Lights at McCormick-Stillman Railroad Park
  • Also new: Winter at the Waterfront (December 5) and Starlight Movie Night: Elf at Scottsdale Civic Center (December 5)
  • Season: November 6 to January 2

Planning a bigger day out? Scottsdale families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Phoenix, which covers ZooLights, Las Noches de las Luminarias and the APS Electric Light Parade.
